The SEC has received its first filings for an Official Trump, Dogecoin and Bonk exchange-traded fund. The SEC's new leadership at the Securities and Exchange Commission is more crypto-friendly.
The SEC received its first filings for Trump, Dogecoin (DOGE) and Bonk (BONK) ETFs. The approval of memecoin-based ETFs is more likely under new SEC acting Chair Mark Uyeda.
